newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil '97 grain crop seen at 77.41 mln tns - Safras.
newsitem.headline: Brazil '97 grain crop seen at 77.41 mln tns - Safras.

text.p: Brazil will harvest a record 77.41 million tonnes of grains and oilseeds in 1997, up from 73.42 million tonnes the previous year, independent consultants Safras e Mercado said.
The rise was due to an increase in planted area in some of the main crops, more widespread use of fertilizers and other inputs and the mainly favorable climate, Safras said in a weekly report.
The figure compares with an earlier forecast for a 77.95 million tonne grains and oilseeds crop and was slightly below government expectations, Safras said.
"The reduction was strictly due to the losses provoked by drought, which reduced the soybean crop in Rio Grande do Sul and the winter corn mid-crop, mainly in Parana," Safras said.
A definitive estimate of this year's harvest will only be possible once it includes the crop in the north-east and all winter crops, which are currently being planted, Safras said.
